summary: Full end-to-end testing of JointCare AI backend + frontend on the public preview URL. Backend pytest suite (20/20 passing) covered auth (admin login, signup for worker/doctor, /auth/me, invalid creds), patient CRUD with BMI auto-compute + search, screening prediction with all required fields, role gating (worker denied on /screenings/{id}/review and /dataset/upload), doctor review + move-out-of-pending, analytics summary structure, dataset upload+info, Emergent LLM AI summary, and WebSocket /api/ws/sensor/{session}. Frontend Playwright E2E covered: signup with role select, dashboard analytics render, patient registration (BMI 27.3 auto-calc), Patient Records list+search+all 4 filter tabs, Screening flow (WebSocket connect => 'Sensor Connected', client-side stream produced 17 readings in ~4.5s, Run OA Prediction navigated to result page), ScreeningResult (30% Moderate meter, sub-scores, contributing factors, mandatory disclaimer text present, AI Summary generated ~970 chars, Download PDF triggered actual download 'JointCare_TEST_UI_e07f84.pdf'), role gating (healthcare_worker to /app/doctor-review is redirected to /app/dashboard, dataset-upload-button is hidden in Settings for worker), admin can access Doctor Review, submit doctor review (Moderate + follow-up + notes) shows 'Review saved' toast and screening moved out of pending list, admin dataset CSV upload shows 'Loaded: ds.csv (2 rows)'. Elderly-mode switch and pending-count testids present.

issues: Recharts logs many 'width(-1) height(-1)' warnings on initial mount – harmless but noisy; consider giving ResponsiveContainer explicit min-height to silence.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py hardcodes LLM model name 'gpt-5.4' which is unusual; if that model id is invalid at runtime the AI summary silently falls back to a deterministic template. During test the LLM call succeeded and returned ~970 chars, so the model id is currently accepted by emergentintegrations, but keep this configurable via env.

server.py CSV parsing uses replace('.','',1).replace('-','',1).isdigit() which will crash if a cell value is empty string ('' has no chars -> isdigit=False, ok) but will also mis-classify things like '1e3'; low-risk placeholder logic though.
PDF is generated fully client-side (jsPDF+QR) – there is no /api/reports/pdf endpoint. That's fine, but the review request mentioned QR in PDF – confirmed generated file downloads without errors.

server.py CORS uses allow_credentials=True with allow_origins='*' (from CORS_ORIGINS). Browsers will reject credentialed requests to wildcard origin; not affecting current bearer-token flow, but tighten if cookies are ever used.
get_current_user still falls back to reading cookies['access_token'] but no endpoint sets that cookie; dead code path.
Route path is /app/doctor-review (not /app/review) – small doc mismatch with the review request wording.
test_credentials: Admin: lakshyabahety15@gmail.com / JointCare@2026. Test worker/doctor accounts are created dynamically per run via /api/auth/register.
seed_data_creation: Each test run creates one TEST_UI_<uniq> patient + screening under a freshly-registered healthcare worker. Admin also uploads a small 2-3 row CSV dataset which is stored in db.datasets (delete_many({}) is called on every upload so this stays bounded).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite lives at /app/backend/tests/test_jointcare_api.py (uses websocket-client, pip installable). Doctor-review route path is /app/doctor-review. Gender/role/village dropdowns are shadcn Select – click the trigger, then use locator('[role=option]', has_text=...).first with force=True (do NOT get_by_text since a hidden native <option> element also matches and Playwright will hit the invisible one). WS endpoint /api/ws/sensor/{session_id} – frontend generates readings client-side and sends via ws; wait ~4s after clicking stream-toggle-button to get >= 8 readings before run-prediction-button. AI summary takes ~10-15s.
rca of the issue: No blocking bugs. Non-blocking: (1) Recharts 'width -1 height -1' warnings on first paint of Dashboard (fix: wrap chart in a min-h-[300px] container); (2) hardcoded LLM model 'gpt-5.4' should be env-driven.
